answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 175400 Country: Jordan Title: Will my wudhu break if a little blood flows out of a cut in my mouth? Question: Is my wudhu broken if a little amount of blood flows out of a cut in my mouth but does not turn my saliva red? I see it flow out of the cut when I look in a mirror but it is a small amount. Answer ID: 175400 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 477/373/H=4/1441) If a little blood flows out of a cut in the mouth and the saliva is not red rather yellow in color then wudhu will not break in such a case. و ان خرج (الدم) من نفس الفم تعتبر الغلبة بينه وبين الريق فان تساويا انتقض الوضوء ويعتبر من حيث اللون فان كان احمر انتقض وان كان اصفر لا ينتقض كذا فى التبيين اهـ الفتاوى الهندية ج 1 ص 11 . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
